info.title: Conference API
info.description: Matching for conferences. Only partners' servers call it, each request with the API key for its conference.

x-versioning.policy: A change that would break partners becomes a new version under a new path prefix, running alongside the old one. A retiring operation is marked deprecated here, with when it was announced, when it is switched off and its successor, and partners are told directly. It is switched off only after the notice agreed with partners, and keeps every security fix until then.

post.summary: Send one talk, several, or the whole programme. All or nothing.

400.description: The request breaks the specification; nothing was applied. Do not retry unchanged.

401.description: No valid API key: the Authorization header must carry this conference's live key, as Bearer <key>.

403.description: The front door's firewall refused the request: it comes from a blocked network address, or carries a known attack. Do not retry unchanged.

404.description: No such conference for this key. Asking for any conference but the key's own gets this same answer.

409.description: The conference holds as much as it may: nothing was applied. The business limits are in x-business-limits.

413.description: The request body is larger than this request allows.

415.description: The body is not JSON in UTF-8, uncompressed.

429.description: Too many requests per minute with this key, or from this network address at the front door's firewall. Or a talks:write would pass the day's limit on new or changed talks for its conference, in x-business-limits; nothing was applied. Retry after the time in Retry-After.

500.description: An unexpected error. Safe to retry: sending the same request again gives the same result.

503.description: The API cannot answer in time just now, or is too busy. Safe to retry after the time in Retry-After.

post.summary: Get matches for text a person enters. It is matched like a new talk, which can take minutes: until it is judged, the answer is {"judging": true}; ask again with the same request, every 30 seconds or more, and once judged it is answered at once, as of the same programme version.

partnerKey.description: The API key for the conference in the path: cmapi_ then 43 characters, sent only in the Authorization header. Each key reaches one conference, expires within a year, and can be cancelled at once.
